title: Issue
description: An issue without its links and its thread: the result of every issue write.

claim.description: The agent session that holds the issue. Null without a claim, and after its end.

requester.description: Who asked for the work, reviews it, and accepts it.

waitingFor.description: The party that has the next step. Null in backlog, done, and wont_do (D134).

problem.description: Markdown. bug: what is wrong, how to see it, and what is expected. change: what is wanted, and how to tell that it is done.

plan.description: Markdown: the steps, the files, and the tests.

result.description: Markdown: what was done, with the commit SHAs, and each deviation from the plan.

followUps.description: Markdown: what came up and was left out.

planRevision.description: The ID of the newest section_changed entry of plan. Null without a plan. approve_plan names it.

planApproval.description: The approval of the plan of planRevision. A plan with new text clears it.

allowedStatuses.description: The statuses that set_issue_status takes from the caller now, with a note and a reviewer where the rules need them.

IssueParty.description: The requester or the assignee of an issue (D134).

userId.description: user: the ID of the user. agent: null.

name.description: user: the login of the user. agent: null.

reviewer.description: The name of the agent that reviewed the plan. Null for an approval of a user.

reviewNote.description: Markdown: the findings of the reviewer. Null for an approval of a user.

IssueClaim.description: A lease of one agent session on the issue (D130). A write of the holder renews it, and a write of another session is refused. It ends at until, with a status change that passes the issue on, or with the release by a user.

holder.description: The agent of the token that wrote.

since.description: The first write of the claim.

until.description: 2 hours after the newest write of the holder.

claim.description: As claim of Issue: skip an issue that another session holds.

waitingFor.description: As waitingFor of Issue: skip an issue that waits for a user.

IssueLink.description: A link of two issues, as one of them reads it. Both issues show it.

issue.description: The other issue of the link.

note.description: Markdown: the reason for the link.

IssueEntry.description: One entry of the thread of an issue. The thread only grows: a new version replaces an entry, and the replaced entry stays.

body.description: comment: the Markdown comment, empty for the answers of a user. section_changed: the Markdown text of this version of the section with history, and null without it, because the issue has the current text. Else null.

questions.description: comment only, else empty. A comment with the label question asks them, a comment with the label answer repeats each one with its answer, and a comment with the label dismissal repeats them without answers (D124).

section.description: section_changed only. The ID of such an entry of plan is a plan revision.

to.description: status_changed only. Equal to from for a hand-over.

waitingFor.description: status_changed: the party that the issue waits for after the change, null for backlog, done, and wont_do. Null on an entry of another kind, and on a status_changed entry stored before D134 that the migration did not translate.

note.description: status_changed only: the Markdown note of the change, when one was given.

reviewer.description: status_changed and plan_approved: the name of the reviewing agent, when one was given.

reviewNote.description: plan_approved only: the Markdown findings of the reviewer.

planRevision.description: plan_approved only: the plan revision that the approval read.

replaces.description: The ID of the entry that this entry replaced. section_changed: the entry of the version before it. comment: the comment that its writer named, for the labels answer and dismissal the question comment. Else null.

replacedBy.description: The ID of the entry that replaced this entry. Null for a current entry. section_changed: the next entry of its section. comment: the comment that names it in replaces. plan_approved: the plan version after the one that it approved.

IssueComment.description: A comment entry with its issue: an item of I5 and list_comments.

id.description: The ID of the entry in the thread of its issue.

body.description: The Markdown comment. Empty for the answers of a user.

questions.description: The questions of a comment with the label question or dismissal, or each question with its answer of a comment with the label answer. Else empty (D124).

thread.description: Oldest first. Without history: no entry with replacedBy.

IssueGraph.description: The result of I9: the dependencies between the open issues of a project (D126). An open issue has a status other than done and wont_do.

issues.description: In key order. The open issues of the project that have a blocked_by link with an open issue, or wait for a user and are not in draft, and the open issues of other projects at the other end of such a link.

blockedBy.description: The issue that it waits for.

links.description: The blocked_by links with at least one issue of the project, in the key order of issue, then of blockedBy. Both keys are in issues.

otherOpenIssues.description: The count of the open issues of the project that are not in issues.

IssueUpdatesPage.description: The result of I10 and get_issue_updates (D128): what changed in a project since a cursor, without the entries of the caller.

cursor.description: Pass as cursor next time. A number of the entry sequence of the project.

hasMore.description: More entries wait: call again at once with cursor.

issues.description: Without a cursor: the issues in todo, in_progress, in_review, and approved, newest updatedAt first. With a cursor: empty.

entries.description: With a cursor: the entries after it, oldest first, as get_issue reads them without history. Without a cursor: empty.

IssueCommits.description: The result of I12 (D132): the commits of the branches whose message or branch name has the issue key, read from the server clones at the time of the call.

subject.description: The subject of the commit message: its first paragraph on one line. Empty for an empty message.

authorName.description: As the commit records it, without a mailmap.

branch.description: Null on the default branch. Else a branch that has the commit, a branch with the key in its name first.

htmlUrl.description: The commit on github.com. Null for a local repository.

items.description: At most 100 commits per repository, newest committedAt first.

reason.description: no_server_copy: the code access pass_through or browser. read_failed: git failed on the clone. Else the reason of repository_unavailable.

unavailable.description: The repositories of the project whose clone the server cannot read, in name order.
